description: Archive a matrix (archived: true, the default) or bring it back (archived: false). Nothing is deleted: list_matrices hides archived matrices unless include_archived is true. Archiving the default matrix hands the default to the oldest active top-level matrix, which only an organization admin may do. Prefer it to delete_matrix when in doubt.

archived.description: true (default) archives, false brings it back

name: archive_matrix
title: Archive a matrix
